G1.BUDGET_ENVELOPE: A budget envelope exists and is approved.
G1.GONOGO: Go / no-go decision ratified by a named party.
G1.OBJECTIVES_STATED: Measurable objectives recorded. Gate 8 measures against these.
G1.JURISDICTION: The project jurisdiction is resolved and populated. Without it no compliance rule can be evaluated at any later gate.
G1.SCOPE_LOCK: Scope locked; spec drawings and sample approvals complete.
G1.AMPLIFY_PLANNED: Capture, rights and measurement requirements for gate 8 are specified. Amplification cannot be retrofitted.
G1.CAPABILITY_FROZEN: Venue capability documents are frozen. A capability record still being edited cannot be reconciled against.

G2.CONTRACTS: Contracts executed; vendors awarded; talent booked; crew recruited.
G2.ACCOUNTABLE_PARTY: Every requirement in the locked scope carries a named accountable party. An unassigned requirement is a gap, not a pass.

G3.PERMITS_FILED: Every permit the jurisdiction requires is filed with lead time in hand.
G3.NO_CRITICAL_GAPS: Reconciliation of every requirement against its capability document leaves zero unresolved critical gaps. An UNKNOWN against a critical requirement counts as a gap.
G3.NO_STALE_DOCS: No requirement or capability document in the advance set is past its validity window.
G3.RIGGING_DOCUMENTED: Where a rigging requirement exists, the venue has a documented point and total load on file. Undocumented capacity is a hard stop.
G3.PO_BASELINE: PO baseline set; gate 9 reconciles against it.

G4.AWARDS: All awards issued; deposits paid; long-lead orders confirmed.
G4.UNITS_RESOLVED: Every awarded line carries a resolved unit. An unresolved unit refuses arithmetic rather than guessing.
G4.BAND_FRESHNESS: No award rests on a price band whose effective confidence has decayed to EXPIRED.

G5.FAB_QC: Fabrication complete; QC passed; punch list opened.
G5.ENGINEERING_STAMPED: Any load-bearing or occupied structure carries stamped engineering for its jurisdiction. An unstamped structure has no capacity anyone will stand behind.
G5.MATERIALS_TRACEABLE: Materials received against purchase orders with variance resolved.

G6.COMMISSIONED: Installed, commissioned, punch list closed; as-builts filed.
G6.AHJ_SIGNOFF: Every permit required by the jurisdiction is inspected and signed off. No rules for an unpopulated jurisdiction means this cannot be evaluated, not that it passes.
G6.EGRESS_VERIFIED: Occupant load, egress width and path verified against the adopted code as built, not as drawn.

G7.ACCEPTANCE: Show closed; strike complete; operating acceptance signed.
G7.INCIDENTS_CLOSED: Every incident, injury and near-miss logged and dispositioned.
G7.CAPTURE_SECURED: Capture media offloaded, checksummed and backed up before strike.

G8.CAPTURE_DELIVERED: Capture assets delivered and archived; broadcast masters delivered; media distribution complete.
G8.RIGHTS_CLEARED: Every published asset has cleared usage rights. UNKNOWN clearance is a blocker; publishing is irreversible.
G8.SPONSOR_OBLIGATIONS: Contracted sponsor deliverables evidenced and the proof-of-performance report issued.
G8.MEASUREMENT_REPORTED: Audience, earned-media and sentiment measurement delivered against the objectives set at gate 1.
G8.ARCHIVE_LODGED: Master assets lodged in the archive of record with retention terms stated.

G9.RECONCILED: Financially reconciled; final cost report filed against the gate 3 baseline.
G9.ASSETS_RETURNED: Every unit-grain asset accounted for: returned, transferred or written off with a named approver.
G9.OBLIGATIONS_DISCHARGED: Permits closed out, bonds released, temporary structures removed, site restored to its documented pre-event state.
G9.USAGE_RECORDED: Element usage written to the usage record.
